help.enable: When disabled, the system DNS is used instead — the built-in DNS server does not run.
help.enhanced-mode: fake-ip returns a fictitious IP and requires TUN/transparent proxying; redir-host returns the real resolution directly.
help.fake-ip-filter: Domains matching here get their real IP instead of a Fake-IP — typically internal domains or anything that needs a genuine address.
help.nameserver: Resolves every domain not covered by nameserver-policy/fallback; supports UDP/TCP/DoT/DoH/DoQ.
help.fallback: Used once the primary DNS servers' result is judged untrustworthy (see the trigger conditions).
help.nameserver-policy: Assigns dedicated DNS servers to specific domains or domain categories — keys are domain/GeoSite rules, values are one or more server addresses.
rule.fallbackFilterGeoipCodeRequiresGeoi: GeoIP triggering is off (geoip: false), so the GeoIP region code has no effect.
